exposure: Surgical management of uterine torsion through ventral celiotomy for cesarean section
outcome: Type of uterine torsion (post cervical, clockwise/anticlockwise)
cohort: The participants were 11 mares presented with signs of colic and diagnosed with uterine torsion, either in full term or advanced stage of pregnancy.
finding: The surgical management of uterine torsion by midline celiotomy for cesarean section resulted in a 90.0% survival rate, with 7 out of 10 surviving mares subsequently breeding successfully.
gest_age: Full term of gestation or advanced stage of pregnancy
